description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldFloat class, which extends SugarWidgetFieldInt to handle float number display and filtering in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes methods for rendering list views and constructing query filters for float fields, considering precision formatting.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldFloat
classes.description: A widget class for handling display and filtering of float number fields in the CRM interface, extending the integer widget class.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Formats and returns the list view representation of a float field, respecting specified precision.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns the plain list view representation of the float field, delegating to displayList.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for filtering records where the float field equals a specific value.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for filtering records where the float field does not equal a specific value.

methods.name: queryFilterGreater
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for filtering records where the float field is greater than a specific value.

methods.name: queryFilterLess
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for filtering records where the float field is less than a specific value.

methods.name: queryFilterBetween
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for filtering records where the float field falls between two values.
